correctness.rationale: On H=C, with two equal weave families, K=(1/2)I, full subspaces, positive weights 1, active Λ_i0=(1/2)I and passive Λ_i1=0, each full weave has energy (1/4)||f||²=||K*f||², hence A=B=1 satisfy the source definitions (m=2>1). For the proper deletion I={0}, ||K†||²=4 and C=sum_i ||Λ_i0||²=1/2. The printed hypothesis 1/2<4 holds and predicts remaining lower A-C=1/2, but all remaining weaves have energy zero for nonzero f in R(K)=H. The original proof actually gives lower A-C||K†||² on R(K), because the deleted sum is <=C||f||²<=C||K†||²||K*f||². Thus the asserted counterexample and repaired SUFFICIENT bound C||K†||²<A are correct. Exact Fraction computations independently confirm all scalar identities. Original six actual pinned Git blob hashes were read with the GitHub connector, current main has exactly the same six hashes, and an independent Git-tree serialization matches 204d3d8d82f0ef666c4f7e32d3126f3c3ac1dfc8. No claim of necessity or optimality is established.
residual_risks: The printed Corollary 2.1 in the source is also affected, but it is outside this submitted claim and has not been fully repaired.
The corrected C quantity overcounts losses across weaving labels, so it is a sufficient bound, not a necessary or sharp criterion.

value.rationale: Avoiding a false erasure guarantee is practically motivated, and the pseudoinverse factor matters sharply. Nevertheless, the exact correction and a stronger (nonzero surviving analysis) counterexample are already provided in a separate public full-text finding. The submitted zero-survivor scalar construction is a routine restriction and rescaling, not an additional structural lemma, natural classification, new boundary or distinct diagnostic. The original paper itself prints the corrected coefficient in the proof. A second publication of this mathematically covered one-dimensional instance adds no independently needed scientific fact under the value standard.
residual_risks: The example is pedagogically simpler, but simplicity alone does not supply independent research value after full same-theorem coverage.
This judgment does not deny the utility of correcting the erroneous 2021 paper; it rejects the duplicated research record.

limitations: Counterexample tests precisely Theorem 2.5 and its printed deletion condition; no general necessity criterion or downstream corollary analysis.
